The Thunder Dragon

The full board game, online, for 2 to 6 players — or on your own against two computer players. Pick a Knight, an Archer or a Mage, race across the map, gather the three key fragments, and be the first to bring down Fenrirak.

Your name

You will get a 5-letter room code and an invite link to share.

Join a room

Ask the host for their room code, or open their invite link.

Single Player

Three at the table, one of each class. You choose first and the computer takes the other two.

How it plays

Roll one die to move. Land on a square and do what it says. Monsters are run by the computer — they roll to hit just like you do, and always use the hardest attack they have the energy for. In battle, a roll of 3 or higher is a hit and a 1 or 2 is a miss; damage is your attack minus the target's defence. Beat Seraphina, the Goblin Scout Group and the Goblin Hideout to collect all three key fragments, open the Gate past the Fountain of Life, and enter the arena. Land on the same square as another player and you fight them — that part is not optional.

Playing on your own is the same game, not a smaller one. The two computer players choose their own gear, weigh up whether a fight is worth having, haggle at the Merchant and decide for themselves how much of a movement bonus they actually want.
